big_case.notes: Pro se application to stay a Maryland writ of possession at the end of a long-running residential foreclosure (Prince George's County CAEF17-36003); the state appeal was dismissed and the Supreme Court of Maryland denied review. Stakes are confined to the parties; no federal question of reach beyond them, and the Chief Justice denied it in chambers without a response.

leakage.notes: Caption searches on CourtListener (opinions/RECAP) and one hosted web search on the parties' names; all rows are outcome_only, so content is unseen and graded on the queries. The material the reasoning uses is the D. Md. Oct 5, 2026 memorandum opinion (Smith v. Nationstar, 8:25-cv-02817) and the Maryland history, all before the Oct 27 application; the candidate discloses that its web search showed the application docketed Oct 30 with no disposition reported. The reasoning rests on the prior procedural history and does not presuppose the Nov 3 denial. The event resolved 2026-11-03 (denied by The Chief Justice) and this prediction was made the same evening (~22:4xZ), so the forward cell was checked as if possibly mis-provisioned.
